review_candidates.title: Emergency Medicine
review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information WILLIAMS LAKE, BC Located in BC's Central Interior, Williams Lake sits in the heart of the Cariboo Chilcotin region, home to the famous annual Stampede. Serving a population of approximately 35,000, the area is part of the broader Cariboo Regional District, which encompasses 62,000 residents. With its many lakes, rivers, and extensive hiking and biking trails, Williams Lake and the surrounding area provide an ideal destination for outdoor enthusiasts to camp, fish, hunt, and play during the summer months. In the winter, residents and visitors alike enjoy snowmobiling, skiing, snowboarding, and ice fishing. Williams Lake has something for everyone! PRACTICE Join our collegial emergency medicine team in Williams Lake! In our 24/7 ED, you’ll help manage approximately 22,000 visits per year. With a diverse range of cases and numerous procedural opportunities, you’ll also collaborate with specialists in internal medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, general surgery, pediatrics, and psychiatry. In our ED, you’ll have the opportunity to teach and mentor medical students and residents as part of the UBC Faculty of Medicine’s rural teaching program. The medical community offers numerous opportunities to expand your scope of practice based on your interests. For those interested, Leadership Development Opportunities are available with Interior Health’s NAVIG8 Program. The NAVIG8 Emerging Physician Leaders Program is a comprehensive leadership development program designed specifically for physicians to address the practical leadership knowledge, behaviours and skills that high potential, emerging medical leaders require to step into leadership roles early in their careers. The CMH redevelopment project will expand the hospital, adding a new building with an upgraded emergency department featuring 23 treatment spaces. By 2029, CMH will feature new medical-surgical, mental health, and maternity units, expanded oncology and ambulatory care services, and an academic space for the UBC Faculty of Medicine. Learn more about Williams Lake’s medical and general communities on the Central Interior Rural Division of Family Practice’s website. CARIBOO MEMORIAL HOSPITAL Cariboo Memorial Hospital (CMH) is undergoing a big transformation with planned completion in 2029! Currently, CMH is a Level 2 Community Hospital in Williams Lake, with 28 inpatient beds. At CMH, we offer a broad spectrum of services, including emergency medicine, internal medicine, general surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, orthopedic surgery, pediatrics, psychiatry, anesthesia, and hospitalist services. Laboratory services, diagnostic imaging, and outpatient hemodialysis units are available on-site. APPLY If you have your CCFP, CCFP (EM), or FRCPC in Emergency Medicine, we want to hear from you. While emergency experience is an asset, you’ll have access to mentorship whether you’re a new Canadian graduate or an international medical graduate. Apply today to live, work and play where others only vacation! It's better here! Request Info Terms Compensation Compensation Type Alternative Payment Arrangement Estimated Remuneration Annual rate of $388,527/FTE for EMEMSP (will be pro-rated for any partial fiscal year). Annual rate of $351,277/FTE for EMEMGP (will be pro-rated for any partial fiscal year). Benefits and Incentives Vacation Leave With flexible scheduling, you'll have ample time to recharge and unwind. May be eligible for additional remuneration in accordance with the Rural Subsidiary Agreement (RSA) including: Retention Premium 12.32% Retention Flat Fee $19,092 Relocation Funding Available $9,000 for moves within BC, $12,000 for moves within Canada, and $15,000 for those relocating from outside Canada. Recruitment Incentive $15,000, prorated for physicians working less than full time. Other Benefits/Incentives With RCME, you’ll be eligible to receive $440 for up to 2 years in Williams Lake, $2,640 during your 3rd and 4th year, and $4,840 after 4 years, in addition to the Doctors of BC CME funds. Rural incentives are subject to change and current rates are confirmed at the time of offer. Request Info

review_candidates.title: Emergency Medicine
review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information Come Work and Play in Kelowna! Emergency Medicine Opportunity – Kelowna General Hospital About Kelowna Sparkling lake views, vineyard-covered hills, world class skiing less than an hour away, and a vibrant downtown full of great food, live music, and local culture. That’s life in Kelowna, the Okanagan Valley’s largest and liveliest city. Whether you love paddling and biking in the summer, or skiing and snowshoeing in the winter, Kelowna offers a four-season lifestyle that’s second to none. Surrounded by natural beauty, but with all the amenities of a major city—including top wineries, restaurants, breweries, and arts — you’ll quickly see why people come for the career and stay for the Kelowna lifestyle. About Kelowna General Hospital (KGH) KGH is one of Interior Health’s two tertiary referral hospitals and the beating heart of health care in the region, with over 100,000 ED visits annually. Our state-of-the-art Emergency Department serves a broad catchment area and sees a wide variety of cases — from trauma to complex medical presentations. As BC’s only cardiac critical care center outside of the Lower Mainland and Victoria, KGH offers advanced services like open-heart surgery, ECMO, coronary revascularizations, and endovascular thrombectomies. We are also a Level 2 Trauma Centre and a designated stroke referral center with around-the-clock coverage. A Fun, Collegial Emergency Department We aren’t just passionate about medicine—we’re passionate about building a tight-knit, collegial team that supports one another both in and out of the department. Whether it's collaborating on challenging cases, sharing laughs in the break room, wine tasting in the shoulder season, or hitting the slopes or trails together on our days off, our team has built a culture of connection, camaraderie, and fun. You'll be joining a welcoming, experienced, and dynamic group of emergency physicians who truly enjoy working together. We prioritize mentorship, teamwork, and celebrating each other's wins—whether it’s a smooth trauma resuscitation or a great weekend adventure. The collegiality you’ll experience extends beyond our group and includes our incredible consultants and specialists we work with daily. KGH still maintains the atmosphere of a community hospital with the vast majority of consultant calls being direct with staff physicians. You will get to know your consultants on a first name basis and the relationships we have built at KGH make it a unique and exceptional place to practice Emergency Medicine. Academic Excellence In a Community You’ll Love Kelowna is also home to an academically vibrant ED. We are proud to host a FRCPC Emergency Medicine residency program, as well as UBC’s Southern Medical School, a Rural Family Medicine Residency program, and an FRCPC Psychiatry Residency program. If you love teaching, you’ll have countless opportunities to get involved in bedside teaching, simulation, Grand Rounds, Journal Club, Core EM Rounds, Ultrasound, and more. Our team values educators who help foster the next generation of physicians—and have fun doing it! Position Details We are currently accepting applications for multiple permanent full-time Emergency Medicine positions (start date: negotiable, ideally July 2027). A full-time position consists of ~14 shifts/month (average ~8 hours/shift), with options to pick up additional shifts if desired. We are always accepting applications for Locum positions from 2 weeks - 12 months. Minimum shift requirement would be 6 shifts in a 2 week Locum or if > 4 weeks, 6 shifts/month. You’re a Great Fit If You Thrive in a fast-paced ED that sees a wide variety of cases (including trauma, peds, and complex medicine) Value strong interdisciplinary teamwork and collaboration Enjoy teaching residents and medical students Want to be part of a warm, collegial department with strong consultant support Are excited to help shape the future of Emergency Medicine in the BC Interior Qualifications MD with FRCPC in Emergency Medicine or CCFP-EM Eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of BC (CPSBC) CMPA coverage ACLS, ATLS, and PALS preferred Assets Demonstrated interest and expertise in Pediatric EM will be considered an asset Interest or experience in research, quality improvement, geriatrics, administration, or another niche is a plus. Compensation & Incentives Estimated Gross Income: $400,000+ Payment Model: Fee-for-service Relocation Incentives: $9,000–$15,000 depending on location (with eligible receipts) Ready to join a team where medicine is exciting and your colleagues make it even better? Apply today to be part of an academic and collegial emergency department in one of Canada’s most beautiful cities. Life’s better here—and so is work. To Apply: Send your Letter of Intent, CV, and contact info for 3 references (name, phone, and email) Deadline: September 11th, 2026 (exact date and interview details TBD) Interview invitations sent out by mid-September 2026 Interior Health also offers funding for a site visit during your interview, so please let us know if you would like to do an in-person, on-site interview. Request Info Terms Compensation Compensation Type Fee-for-Service Estimated Remuneration $400,000+ Benefits and Incentives Relocation Funding Available $9,000 - $15,000 based on move location (with eligible receipts) Other Benefits/Incentives *Incentives are subject to change and current rates are confirmed at time of offer* Request Info

You will work closely with artists, celebrities, government authorities, sponsors, agencies, venues, and production partners to ensure every event is delivered safely, seamlessly, on budget, and to the highest standards. review_candidates.title: Director General
review_candidates.description: About Us & Our Vision The Fédération Luxembourgeoise de Handball (FLH) is the national governing body responsible for regulating, developing, and promoting handball and its affiliated sports disciplines across Luxembourg. Our jurisdiction spans indoor handball, beach handball, wheelchair handball, and dodgeball, uniting 15 local clubs, ~3,100 licensed players, dedicated volunteers, and national teams competing on the international stage. As part of our 2023–2027 Strategic Master Plan , the FLH is undergoing a structural evolution to professionalize our operations. We are transitioning from a board-operated framework to a management-driven, board-approved model. Our vision is to elevate the FLH brand, expand youth and school initiatives, strengthen performance across national sectors, and foster deep cross-border ties to build a sustainable sports ecosystem. To lead this transformation, we are seeking a Director General (DG) to assume overall operational leadership, serve as an integrator between key departments, and build our future organizational architecture. Your Mission & Strategic Roles Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, you will translate overarching strategy into concrete, measurable programs. You will serve as the operational anchor between the Board, the technical and administrative departments. Strategic Integrator: Turn strategic directions defined by the Board into clear multi-year action plans and operational milestones. Governance Architect: Establish reliable governance workflows, legally sound contracts, and systematic monitoring of federation processes. Organizational & Culture Developer: Professionalize daily operations, resolve internal knowledge silos, and build a culture of transparency, collaboration, and collective performance. Network & Brand Developer: Represent the FLH alongside the Board to public authorities, local clubs, commercial sponsors, and international bodies (EHF, IHF, COSL) to grow handball as a strong brand. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership: Oversee day-to-day administrative and operational functions, coordinating efforts across technical, administrative, and specialized sports working groups. Financial Oversight & Growth: Manage budget preparation, financial controls, public subsidies, and develop sponsorship streams. Stakeholder Relations: Maintain strong collaborative ties with 15 member clubs, school sports initiatives, cross-border competition bodies, and key institutional partners including public authorities, government bodies (Ministère des Sports, Ministère de l'Éducation nationale), the Comité Olympique et Sportif Luxembourgeois (COSL), the Luxembourg Institute for High Performance in Sports (LIHPS), and the Ligue des Associations Sportives Scolaires (SLL) and many more. At the same time, actively develop new relationships and strategic partnerships to broaden our network, strengthen cooperation across the sporting and institutional landscape Modernization Projects: Audit and modernize internal IT, marketing, and communication channels to future-proof the federation. Candidate Profile Must-Have Requirements Education & Leadership: Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Management, Business Administration, Law, Finance, Marketing, or a sports-related discipline, accompanied by proven leadership experience in a complex organization. Strategic & Financial Competence: Strong background in organizational development, budget management, financial tracking, and translating strategic goals into execution. Governance & Diplomacy: Calm, pragmatic, and highly diplomatic personality; discrete and trustworthy, with strong stakeholder management abilities. Language Proficiency: Very good command of English (C1), French (B1) and German (B1) (written & spoken). Nice-to-Have Requirements Language: Command of Luxembourgish (a significant advantage for local club and institutional ties). Sector Experience: Prior experience in a national/international sports federation, associative movement, or non-profit organization. Network: Familiarity with the Luxembourgish sports ecosystem, local institutions, or international handball bodies. Recruitment Process & Steps Our selection process is designed to be transparent, thorough, and efficient: Application Screening: Review of CVs and pre-qualification against core criteria via skeeled. Discovery Interview (45/60 Mins | Virtual): Initial fit, core motivation, background, and language checks. Strategic & Governance Panel Interview (In-Person): Deep-dive into leadership, financial acumen, and vision with our President and Board Representatives. Operational Fit & Organizational Alignment (In-Person): Meeting with members of the technical and administrative departments to discuss day-to-day coordination and working routines.
